line: A reconstruction: an invented fellowship's teaching tape. Every lesson is quoted or closely paraphrased from a ministry handbook and an Exodus booklet (1995, 1996); its two adverts are built on the Exodus booklet series and a 1987 booklet price. All are held in the Smithsonian's Love in Action Collection.
made: Made in code for YOUR UPDATE HAS FAILED by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5), UiB job 28 (S395), 16 Nov 2026: the pictures drawn frame by frame in headless Chrome; v5's felt board, felt Lamby, CG and adverts re-shot for the LambyVision glass.
music: Music: made in code for these tapes by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5) — the bed “Open Door” (1997-B, his pick); the adverts' jingle is v3's TriedPath theme (made in code for this tape, S389)
voices: Build-time Supertonic 3 through tools/tts/render.py, register 'apparatus' only (his picks): narrator stock voice F3 (0.92, 14 steps), announcer M1 (0.97, 16 steps). v5's renders, and one new line with the same voice (“Part two. Displacement. Putting off, putting on.”). Lamby has no voice.
invented: TriedPath Fellowship, its Pocket Library, the “Mountains of Material” cassette set, the booklet titles on the covers, the fellowship hall, the phone numbers (fictional 555-01xx), Lamby's bubbles and the felt board are the piece's. No real person is shown or named.

facts.text: December 1973: the American Psychiatric Association's Board of Trustees voted to remove homosexuality from the DSM.
facts.source: Jack Drescher, “Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality”, Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015 (PMC4695779), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: 1987: “ego-dystonic homosexuality” was removed from the next revision, DSM-III-R.
facts.source: Jack Drescher, “Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality”, Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015 (PMC4695779), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: May 1990: the World Health Assembly adopted ICD-10 (WHA43.24; in effect from 1 January 1993). ICD-10, block F66, Note: “Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder.”
facts.source: World Health Organization, ICD-10 (browser, 2019 version), block F66, Note, https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en/GetConcept?ConceptId=F66 read 15 Nov 2026; adoption “May 1990 (WHA43.24)”, https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases read 15 Nov 2026
